            if grid[r][c] == fg and c >= len(grid[r]) - 2:
                if r and grid[r-1][c] == fg:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    return out

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # foreground run is the incomplete/outlier motif. Mark the continuation

    bg = max(range(10), key=lambda k: sum(v == k for row in grid for v in row))

    for r in range(len(grid) - 2):
        color = next((v for v in grid[r] if v != bg), None)
        if color is None:
            continue
        cols = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v == color]
        if len(cols) < 1:
            continue

        if (grid[r+1][0] == color and grid[r+1][1] == color and
            grid[r+2][0] == color and grid[r+2][1] == color):
            candidates.append((len(cols), r, color, max(cols)))
    if len(candidates) >= 2:
        shortest = min(x[0] for x in candidates)
        longest_end = max(x[3] for x in candidates)
        # Choose the last of the shortest motifs, matching the demonstrated
        # outlier convention; recolor its missing continuation.

''')
